SELECT id,goal_id,id AS stage_id FROM stage WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT t.id,t.stage_id,s.goal_id FROM task t JOIN stage s ON s.id=t.stage_id AND s.user_id=t.user_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.id=#{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL::bigint AS id WHERE false

mapper.select: WITH segments AS ( SELECT es.id AS execution_id,es.status,sg.started_at, LEAST(#{ctx.now},COALESCE(sg.ended_at,LEAST(#{ctx.now},es.last_heartbeat_at +make_interval(secs=>sg.heartbeat_timeout_seconds),sg.eligible_until))) AS ends_at FROM execution_session es JOIN execution_segment sg ON sg.execution_id=es.id JOIN task t ON t.id=es.task_id AND t.user_id=es.user_id JOIN stage st ON st.id=t.stage_id AND st.user_id=es.user_id WHERE es.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND (#{ctx.goalId}::bigint IS NULL OR st.goal_id=#{ctx.goalId}) AND (#{ctx.stageId}::bigint IS NULL OR st.id=#{ctx.stageId}) AND (#{ctx.taskId}::bigint IS NULL OR t.id=#{ctx.taskId}) ), lengths AS ( SELECT *,GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ends_at-started_at)*1000) AS total_ms, GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(ends_at,#{ctx.toInstant})-GREATEST(started_at,#{ctx.fromInstant}))*1000) AS range_ms FROM segments ) SELECT floor(COALESCE(sum(total_ms),0)/1000)::bigint AS total_actual_seconds, floor(COALESCE(sum(range_ms),0)/1000)::bigint AS range_actual_seconds, COALESCE(sum(total_ms),0)::bigint AS total_actual_milliseconds, COALESCE(sum(range_ms),0)::bigint AS range_actual_milliseconds, count(DISTINCT execution_id) FILTER (WHERE total_ms>0) AS total_sessions, count(DISTINCT execution_id) FILTER (WHERE range_ms>0) AS range_sessions, count(DISTINCT execution_id) FILTER (WHERE total_ms>0 AND status='FINISHED') AS total_finished_sessions, count(DISTINCT execution_id) FILTER (WHERE range_ms>0 AND status='FINISHED') AS range_finished_sessions, max(started_at) FILTER (WHERE total_ms>0) AS last_execution_at FROM lengths

WITH days AS ( SELECT (#{ctx.dateFrom}+n)::date AS business_date,(#{ctx.dateFrom}+n)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE #{ctx.timeZone} AS starts_at, (#{ctx.dateFrom}+n+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE #{ctx.timeZone} AS ends_at FROM generate_series(0,#{ctx.dateTo}-#{ctx.dateFrom}) AS n ), segments AS ( SELECT es.id AS execution_id,es.status,sg.started_at, LEAST(#{ctx.now},COALESCE(sg.ended_at,LEAST(#{ctx.now},es.last_heartbeat_at +make_interval(secs=>sg.heartbeat_timeout_seconds),sg.eligible_until))) AS ends_at FROM execution_session es JOIN execution_segment sg ON sg.execution_id=es.id JOIN task t ON t.id=es.task_id AND t.user_id=es.user_id JOIN stage st ON st.id=t.stage_id AND st.user_id=es.user_id WHERE es.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND (#{ctx.goalId}::bigint IS NULL OR st.goal_id=#{ctx.goalId}) AND (#{ctx.stageId}::bigint IS NULL OR st.id=#{ctx.stageId}) AND (#{ctx.taskId}::bigint IS NULL OR t.id=#{ctx.taskId}) ), clipped AS ( SELECT d.business_date,s.execution_id,s.status, -- 空白日保留在结果中，但无执行段时必须为零；不能让 NULL 边界进入 LEAST/GREATEST。 CASE WHEN s.execution_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAST(d.ends_at,s.ends_at)-GREATEST(d.starts_at,s.started_at)))*1000) END AS milliseconds FROM days d LEFT JOIN segments s ON s.started_at<d.ends_at AND s.ends_at>d.starts_at ) SELECT business_date,COALESCE(sum(milliseconds),0)::bigint AS actual_milliseconds, floor(COALESCE(sum(milliseconds),0)/1000)::bigint AS actual_seconds, count(DISTINCT execution_id) FILTER (WHERE milliseconds>0) AS sessions, count(DISTINCT execution_id) FILTER (WHERE milliseconds>0 AND status='FINISHED') AS finished_sessions FROM clipped GROUP BY business_date ORDER BY business_date

WITH days AS ( SELECT (#{ctx.dateFrom}::date + n)::date AS business_date FROM generate_series(0, #{ctx.dateTo}::date - #{ctx.dateFrom}::date) AS n ), habit_days AS ( SELECT d.business_date,h.id AS habit_id,h.status,h.deleted_at, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.revision_id ELSE r.id END AS revision_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.category_id ELSE r.category_id END AS category_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.name ELSE r.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.expected_time ELSE r.expected_time END AS expected_time, c.id AS checkin_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done_count, 1 AS due_count FROM habit h CROSS JOIN days d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ci.id,ci.revision_id,cr.category_id,cr.name,cr.expected_time FROM habit_checkin ci JOIN habit_revision cr ON cr.id=ci.revision_id AND cr.habit_id=h.id AND cr.user_id=h.user_id WHERE ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.business_date=d.business_date AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL ) c ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT hr.id,hr.category_id,hr.name,hr.expected_time,hr.status_snapshot,hr.deleted_snapshot, hr.start_date,hr.weekday_mask FROM habit_revision hr WHERE hr.habit_id=h.id AND hr.user_id=h.user_id AND hr.effective_date<=d.business_date ORDER BY hr.effective_date DESC,hr.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND ( c.id IS NOT NULL OR (r.status_snapshot='ACTIVE' AND NOT r.deleted_snapshot AND r.start_date<=d.business_date AND (r.weekday_mask::integer & (1 << (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.business_date)::integer-1)))<>0) ) ) SELECT COALESCE(sum(done_count),0)::bigint AS done_count,COALESCE(sum(due_count),0)::bigint AS due_count, round(100.0*sum(done_count)/NULLIF(sum(due_count),0),2) AS completion_rate FROM habit_days

WITH days AS ( SELECT (#{ctx.dateFrom}::date + n)::date AS business_date FROM generate_series(0, #{ctx.dateTo}::date - #{ctx.dateFrom}::date) AS n ), habit_days AS ( SELECT d.business_date,h.id AS habit_id,h.status,h.deleted_at, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.revision_id ELSE r.id END AS revision_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.category_id ELSE r.category_id END AS category_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.name ELSE r.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.expected_time ELSE r.expected_time END AS expected_time, c.id AS checkin_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done_count, 1 AS due_count FROM habit h CROSS JOIN days d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ci.id,ci.revision_id,cr.category_id,cr.name,cr.expected_time FROM habit_checkin ci JOIN habit_revision cr ON cr.id=ci.revision_id AND cr.habit_id=h.id AND cr.user_id=h.user_id WHERE ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.business_date=d.business_date AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL ) c ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT hr.id,hr.category_id,hr.name,hr.expected_time,hr.status_snapshot,hr.deleted_snapshot, hr.start_date,hr.weekday_mask FROM habit_revision hr WHERE hr.habit_id=h.id AND hr.user_id=h.user_id AND hr.effective_date<=d.business_date ORDER BY hr.effective_date DESC,hr.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND ( c.id IS NOT NULL OR (r.status_snapshot='ACTIVE' AND NOT r.deleted_snapshot AND r.start_date<=d.business_date AND (r.weekday_mask::integer & (1 << (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.business_date)::integer-1)))<>0) ) ) SELECT business_date,COALESCE(sum(done_count),0)::bigint AS done_count,COALESCE(sum(due_count),0)::bigint AS due_count, round(100.0*sum(done_count)/NULLIF(sum(due_count),0),2) AS completion_rate FROM habit_days GROUP BY business_date ORDER BY business_date

habit_id,h.status,h.deleted_at, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.revision_id ELSE r.id END AS revision_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.category_id ELSE r.category_id END AS category_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.name ELSE r.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.expected_time ELSE r.expected_time END AS expected_time, c.id AS checkin_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL habit_revision cr ON cr.id=ci.revision_id AND cr.habit_id=h.id AND cr.user_id=h.user_id WHERE ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.business_date=d.business_date AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL AND hr.user_id=h.user_id AND hr.effective_date<=d.business_date ORDER BY hr.effective_date DESC,hr.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND ( c.id IS NOT NULL OR (r.status_snapshot='ACTIVE' AND NOT r.deleted_snapshot AND r.start_date<=d.business_date AND (r.weekday_mask::integer & (1 << (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.business_date)::integer-1)))<>0) ) ), groups AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN #{groupBy}='HABIT' THEN habit_id ELSE category_id END AS group_id,COALESCE(sum(done_count),0)::bigint AS done_count,COALESCE(sum(due_count),0)::bigint AS due_count, round(100.0*sum(done_count)/NULLIF(sum(due_count),0),2) AS completion_rate FROM habit_days GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT g.group_id::text AS id, CASE WHEN #{groupBy}='HABIT' THEN hr.name ELSE COALESCE(c.name,'未分类') END AS name, CASE WHEN #{groupBy}='HABIT' THEN h.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ELSE c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL END AS deleted, g.done_count,g.due_count,g.completion_rate FROM groups g LEFT JOIN habit h ON #{groupBy}='HABIT' AND h.id=g.group_id AND h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} LEFT JOIN habit_revision hr ON hr.habit_id=h.id AND hr.user_id=h.user_id AND hr.revision_no=h.current_revision_no LEFT JOIN habit_category c ON #{groupBy}='CATEGORY' AND c.id=g.group_id AND c.user_id=#{ctx.userId} ORDER BY g.group_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH days AS ( SELECT (#{ctx.dateFrom}::date + n)::date AS business_date FROM generate_series(0, #{ctx.dateTo}::date - #{ctx.dateFrom}::date) AS n ), habit_days AS ( SELECT d.business_date,h.id AS habit_id,h.status,h.deleted_at, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.revision_id ELSE r.id END AS revision_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.category_id ELSE r.category_id END AS category_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.name ELSE r.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.expected_time ELSE r.expected_time END AS expected_time, c.id AS checkin_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done_count, 1 AS due_count FROM habit h CROSS JOIN days d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ci.id,ci.revision_id,cr.category_id,cr.name,cr.expected_time FROM habit_checkin ci JOIN habit_revision cr ON cr.id=ci.revision_id AND cr.habit_id=h.id AND cr.user_id=h.user_id WHERE ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.business_date=d.business_date AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL ) c ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT hr.id,hr.category_id,hr.name,hr.expected_time,hr.status_snapshot,hr.deleted_snapshot, hr.start_date,hr.weekday_mask FROM habit_revision hr WHERE hr.habit_id=h.id AND hr.user_id=h.user_id AND hr.effective_date<=d.business_date ORDER BY hr.effective_date DESC,hr.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND ( c.id IS NOT NULL OR (r.status_snapshot='ACTIVE' AND NOT r.deleted_snapshot AND r.start_date<=d.business_date AND (r.weekday_mask::integer & (1 << (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.business_date)::integer-1)))<>0) ) ) SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN #{groupBy}='HABIT' THEN habit_id ELSE category_id END FROM habit_days GROUP BY 1 ) grouped

WITH events AS (SELECT 'GOAL' AS kind,h.goal_id AS object_id,h.event_type,h.after_status,h.occurred_at FROM goal_state_history h WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND (#{ctx.goalId}::bigint IS NULL OR h.goal_id=#{ctx.goalId}) UNION ALL SELECT 'STAGE',h.stage_id,h.event_type,h.after_status,h.occurred_at FROM stage_state_history h JOIN stage s ON s.id=h.stage_id AND s.user_id=h.user_id WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND (#{ctx.goalId}::bigint IS NULL OR s.goal_id=#{ctx.goalId}) AND (#{ctx.stageId}::bigint IS NULL OR s.id=#{ctx.stageId}) UNION ALL SELECT 'TASK',h.task_id,h.event_type,h.after_status,h.occurred_at FROM task_state_history h JOIN task t ON t.id=h.task_id AND t.user_id=h.user_id JOIN stage s ON s.id=t.stage_id AND s.user_id=h.user_id WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND (#{ctx.goalId}::bigint IS NULL OR s.goal_id=#{ctx.goalId}) AND (#{ctx.stageId}::bigint IS NULL OR s.id=#{ctx.stageId}) AND (#{ctx.taskId}::bigint IS NULL OR t.id=#{ctx.taskId})) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='GOAL' AND e.event_type='STATUS_CHANGED' AND e.after_status='COMPLETED') AS goal_completion_actions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='STAGE' AND e.event_type='STATUS_CHANGED' AND e.after_status='COMPLETED') AS stage_completion_actions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='TASK' AND e.event_type IN ('STATUS_CHANGED','COMPLETION_IMPORTED') AND e.after_status='COMPLETED') AS task_completion_actions, count(DISTINCT e.object_id) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='TASK' AND e.event_type IN ('STATUS_CHANGED','COMPLETION_IMPORTED') AND e.after_status='COMPLETED') AS completed_distinct_tasks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='GOAL' AND e.event_type='ARCHIVED') AS goal_archive_actions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='GOAL' AND e.event_type='RESTORED') AS goal_restore_actions FROM events e WHERE e.occurred_at>=#{ctx.fromInstant} AND e.occurred_at<#{ctx.toInstant}

WITH days AS (SELECT (#{ctx.dateFrom}::date+n)::date AS business_date FROM generate_series(0,#{ctx.dateTo}::date-#{ctx.dateFrom}::date) n), events AS (SELECT 'GOAL' AS kind,h.goal_id AS object_id,h.event_type,h.after_status,h.occurred_at FROM goal_state_history h WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND (#{ctx.goalId}::bigint IS NULL OR h.goal_id=#{ctx.goalId}) UNION ALL SELECT 'STAGE',h.stage_id,h.event_type,h.after_status,h.occurred_at FROM stage_state_history h JOIN stage s ON s.id=h.stage_id AND s.user_id=h.user_id WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND (#{ctx.goalId}::bigint IS NULL OR s.goal_id=#{ctx.goalId}) AND (#{ctx.stageId}::bigint IS NULL OR s.id=#{ctx.stageId}) UNION ALL SELECT 'TASK',h.task_id,h.event_type,h.after_status,h.occurred_at FROM task_state_history h JOIN task t ON t.id=h.task_id AND t.user_id=h.user_id JOIN stage s ON s.id=t.stage_id AND s.user_id=h.user_id WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND (#{ctx.goalId}::bigint IS NULL OR s.goal_id=#{ctx.goalId}) AND (#{ctx.stageId}::bigint IS NULL OR s.id=#{ctx.stageId}) AND (#{ctx.taskId}::bigint IS NULL OR t.id=#{ctx.taskId})) SELECT d.business_date,count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='GOAL' AND e.event_type='STATUS_CHANGED' AND e.after_status='COMPLETED') AS goal_completion_actions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='STAGE' AND e.event_type='STATUS_CHANGED' AND e.after_status='COMPLETED') AS stage_completion_actions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='TASK' AND e.event_type IN ('STATUS_CHANGED','COMPLETION_IMPORTED') AND e.after_status='COMPLETED') AS task_completion_actions, count(DISTINCT e.object_id) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='TASK' AND e.event_type IN ('STATUS_CHANGED','COMPLETION_IMPORTED') AND e.after_status='COMPLETED') AS completed_distinct_tasks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='GOAL' AND e.event_type='ARCHIVED') AS goal_archive_actions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind='GOAL' AND e.event_type='RESTORED') AS goal_restore_actions FROM days d LEFT JOIN events e ON e.occurred_at>=#{ctx.fromInstant} AND e.occurred_at<#{ctx.toInstant} AND (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE #{ctx.timeZone})::date=d.business_date GROUP BY d.business_date ORDER BY d.business_date
